components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid sapphire action; every primary CTA on the site.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White outlined companion to the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #334155; font-family: Geist, 'Geist Fallback', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a4b82; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hero Search
components.description: The main hero action: search field with embedded primary button.

components.css: .ds-portal { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 420px; padding: 20px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid #d8e8f6; border-radius: 16px; background: rgb(238 245 251 / 0.4); font-family: Geist, 'Geist Fallback', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-portal:hover { border-color: #b5d5ef; background: rgb(238 245 251 / 0.7); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(32 131 196 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(32 131 196 / 0.1); } .ds-portal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a4b82; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-portal-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-portal-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #d8e8f6; background: #fff; color: #0a4b82; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-portal-count { padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(216 232 246 / 0.8); color: #07345b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-portal-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 16px 0 0; color: #0f172a; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-portal-arrow { color: #0a4b82; transition: transform 150ms; } .ds-portal:hover .ds-portal-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-portal-body { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #475569; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; }

narrative.overview:
StudyBG uses the visual world of its sister site Матура Плюс, a quiet, institutional academy. The surface is a white sheet with a faint sapphire light at the top. It carries two brand voices: sapphire for action and emerald for success. The goal is to look like one family with Матура Плюс while keeping the StudyBG name and wordmark. This world replaced an earlier "tactile EdTech" system that used ten subject colors, 3D buttons and emoji. Leaving those behind is the point of the port.

Density is high, because the site carries a whole national curriculum. The calm comes from discipline, not from empty space. Every container is a white or lightly tinted card with a slate hairline and a soft shadow. Every action is a solid sapphire or white-outlined button. Every icon is a Lucide line icon in slate or a brand color. Hierarchy comes from Geist weight and size, the sapphire highlight inside a headline, and the contrast between the white ground and one deep sapphire band per section.

The world ships light-only (`color-scheme: light`). Motion is limited to color transitions, a 4px arrow nudge on hover, a 0.98 press scale, and a 1.05 logo scale. All of it collapses under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
keyCharacteristics: White ground with a radial sapphire glow at 5% opacity at the top of the page.
Two brand colors: sapphire for actions, links, highlights and focus, and emerald for success, streaks and the "BG" of the wordmark.
Amber belongs to the "Мистерии" / "Обща култура" portal. Rose marks errors and wrong answers only.
Geist variable (100–900, Cyrillic subsets), self-hosted, with a metric-matched Arial fallback.
Cards with 16px corners, slate-200 borders and soft low shadows. Buttons with 8px corners.
Lucide line icons only. No emoji, no gradient text, no 3D bottom edges.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Sapphire acts and emerald confirms. No third brand hue exists. The token remap sends every legacy blue/indigo/violet/purple/fuchsia/pink/cyan class to sapphire and every emerald/green/teal class to emerald, so an inner screen cannot reintroduce a rainbow through Tailwind classes. Don't add new hue scales.

rules.name: The Portal Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber surfaces (tinted cards, filled buttons, tags) belong to the "Мистерии" / "Обща култура" portal. Elsewhere amber appears only as small state accents already in the build: the daily-streak flame chip, the "Пауза" state of the focus timer, and the explanation note after a wrong answer.

rules.name: The Rose Means Wrong Rule
rules.body: Rose marks a wrong choice, an error count or a destructive action. It never decorates.

rules.name: The One Highlight Rule
rules.body: A headline may carry one sapphire phrase as solid color. It never uses gradient text.

rules.name: The Counted Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every count (lessons, dossiers, questions) is set `tabular-nums` and comes from the data.

rules.name: The Soft Edge Rule
rules.body: Depth is a soft blur under a hairline. There are no hard offset shadows and no thick bottom borders as a 3D edge.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: The deep sapphire band (a 135° gradient from #083861 through #0a4b82 to #145a96, white text, emerald-300 icons) marks the single high-emphasis panel of a section: the focus timer, the express flashcards and the Матура Плюс bridge. It is one hue at three depths, never a multi-color gradient.

dos: Do route every action through solid sapphire (#0a4b82) with 8px corners, hover to #0e5e9e, and press at 0.98 scale.
Do build containers as white 16px cards with a 1px slate-200 border and the resting soft shadow.
Do use Lucide line icons at 14–20px in slate-400/500, or in the brand color of their context.
Do reserve the sapphire band gradient (#083861 → #0a4b82 → #145a96) for one high-emphasis panel per section.
Do keep amber surfaces inside the "Мистерии" / "Обща култура" portal and rose for wrong or error states.
Do set every count `tabular-nums` and source it from the data.
donts: Don't use emoji as icons or inside UI strings.
Don't use gradient text. Highlight one headline phrase in solid sapphire instead.
Don't add 3D bottom edges (thick `border-b-4` ledges) or hard offset shadows.
Don't put kicker or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't introduce per-subject colors or new hue scales. The remap to two brands is the system.
